title: Shopify Products Data Scraper – Full Catalog, Shopify CSV
description: Every product from any Shopify store or collection: prices, variants, SKUs, barcodes, stock counts, availability, images, tags. Filter by price, sale, brand, type or stock. Overlapping collections deduped: one row, one charge per product. Watch a store: drops, restocks, new, delisted. No browser.
seoTitle: Shopify Products Scraper – Store Catalog to JSON/CSV
seoDescription: Scrape any Shopify store's catalog to JSON/CSV: titles, prices, variants, SKUs, barcodes, stock counts. Overlapping collections deduped — pay once per product. Or watch for price drops and restocks.

result.eventDescription: One product returned to the dataset.

productDetail.eventDescription: Extra fetch of the product's live page and per-product JSON for barcodes, inventory counts, seoTitle, seoDescription, ratingValue and reviewCount. Only charged when detailLevel is "full".
